verdict.rationale: Mailgun's docs show basic merge-field personalization through Recipient Variables for batch sending and Template Variables with mailing lists. They also mention 'email previews' as part of an email-quality toolset. Nothing in the evidence describes a templating language with conditionals or loops, or a way to test-render a stored template before sending. Missing for 10: documented templating syntax (e.g. Handlebars-style), conditionals, loops, template storage/versioning, a test-render or preview API tied to templates, and independent corroboration.
